externalSource.description: Authoring provenance; omitted leaves provenance handling to Hex.

id.description: Optional discriminator for that external source.

base.description: GitHub instance URL; omission uses Hex's github.com default.

commitHash.description: Commit hash of the uploaded revision.

anyOf.description: GitHub authoring provenance for the uploaded revision.

overwriteDifferentSource.description: Allow overwriting a same-path guide authored from another source; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_hex_upsertguidedraft.description: One workspace guide path and its complete replacement draft text, with optional authoring provenance.

items.description: A guide record actually reported by Hex.
Guide records actually reported by Hex; not inferred successes.
A provider warning for an affected guide path.

FunctionOutput_hex_upsertguidedraft.description: Guide records and warnings reported by Hex for this draft write, with the provider request identifier.

tags.instructions: Use for one guide; use `batch-upsert-guide-drafts` for several. Supply ordinary guide text and its file path. Existing draft content is replaced. overwriteDifferentSource allows taking over a same-path guide from another authoring source; it is not a confirmation flag. Publish separately with `update-guide-draft-publication`.
